issue.title: test_run_workspace_git_command_recovers_stale_index_lock flakes under loaded scoped check
issue.description:
## Flake report

- **Test:** `tests/test_sase_utils.py::test_run_workspace_git_command_recovers_stale_index_lock`
- **Repro:** `sase tool run check` (scoped parallel lane), then `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_sase_utils.py::test_run_workspace_git_command_recovers_stale_index_lock -q --tb=short`

Failed once under the loaded scoped `just check` lane with `assert False is True` (`run_workspace_command` returned `success is False` after `git add` against a tmp repo that had an aged `.git/index.lock`). The same node then passed on an unchanged tree in isolation (1 passed in 2.10s). This agent did not touch git-lock recovery; the surrounding work was a TUI `_loading.py` split. Fail rate 1/2 observed; serial isolation pass; parallel/loaded check fail.

task_type_fields.evidence: Failed once in the scoped parallel check lane (assert False is True on run_workspace_command success). Passed immediately after on the same tree in isolation: 1 passed in 2.10s. Fail rate 1/2. Serial isolation pass; loaded parallel fail.

issue.creation_reason: Scoped just check failed this git-lock recovery test once, then the same node passed in isolation on an unchanged tree. The surrounding work did not touch git-lock recovery.

payload.description: Adjacent git-lock flake: maintenance.lock during copytree, not index.lock recovery

evidence.note: Landing triage of PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP from sase-1kj.8.1.3 note #3 adds a second caller of the same abandoned .git/index.lock recovery: tests/ace/tui/test_session_proc_reporter_git_lock.py::test_reporter_dev_command_runner_recovers_abandoned_ff_lock. ToolRun 3652943e582592c9f19aec77808f3907 returned 1 from git merge --ff-only; its recovery log explicitly preserved the stale lock because permission was denied reading /proc/2193656/fd. Both this reporter path (dev_update.command) and the task original core.shell caller use run_with_git_lock_retry with aged fixture locks and 0.001s retries. Same shared stale-lock remediation, not maintenance.lock copytree. Phase isolated rerun and lander rerun at d69cd499dd pass. Expand this existing investigation rather than create a duplicate; do not weaken live-lock safety.
